topic: how much of every dollar booked on Uber rides ends up as Uber revenue
storyAngle: Uber keeps roughly thirty cents of each dollar booked, which is not the same as what the driver is paid.
doNotClaim: Take rate = Uber revenue / gross bookings. Gross bookings include taxes, tolls and fees, so NEVER say what share of a rider fare or of driver pay this equals.
Do not state any dollar split of a specific fare.

facts.claim: In the last quarter of 2024 (Q4), Uber MOBILITY (rides) take rate was 30.3%: Uber revenue as a share of gross bookings, so say "of every dollar BOOKED" (never "of every dollar you pay"); it was 28.7% a year earlier.
say: about thirty cents on the dollar

facts.claim: In that same last quarter of 2024 (one quarter, not a year), Uber Mobility revenue was $6.9 billion on gross bookings of $22.8 billion.
